interest: Illuminates Taiwan's colonial finances, American hydroelectric bond flotation, and fiscal transition toward Japanese wartime mobilization.
overview: This file comprises U.S. consular despatches, reports, and State Department memoranda from 1930 to 1939 documenting the financial conditions and budgetary planning of Taiwan under Japanese colonial administration. It details annual budgets, monopoly revenues, public infrastructure including the J.P. Morgan-backed Lake Jitsugetsutan hydroelectric project and port expansions, capital controls, and the fiscal transition to wartime mobilization and military transfers during the Second Sino-Japanese War.
